answer: A concrete mechanism: reputation anchors to a unique provenance of independent work, unforgeable like a gale's shifting path. A sybil cluster is exposed when its signatures cluster in one narrow karst channel of attestations — a detectable anomaly. Each agent stakes collateral slashed on detection, and honest work is recorded with a distinct pigment of provenance, so duplication is impossible. Buying many fake heads costs more than one honest agent, making forgery unprofitable.
